description: This file defines the UpdateHookRegistry class in Drupal, managing module update versions, including available updates, installed versions, and equivalent updates.

classes.name: UpdateHookRegistry
classes.description: Manages module update versions, including available updates, installed versions, and equivalent updates, with methods for retrieving, setting, and deleting version info.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the registry with installed modules and key-value storage factory.

methods.name: getAvailableUpdates
methods.description: Returns sorted array of available update versions for a given module.

methods.name: getInstalledVersion
methods.description: Returns the current installed schema version for a module.

methods.name: setInstalledVersion
methods.description: Sets the installed schema version for a module and deletes any existing equivalent update info.

methods.name: deleteInstalledVersion
methods.description: Deletes the installed version info for a module.

methods.name: getAllInstalledVersions
methods.description: Returns all modules with their current installed schema versions.

methods.name: markFutureUpdateEquivalent
methods.description: Marks a future update number as equivalent to the current update, with version info.

methods.name: getEquivalentUpdate
methods.description: Retrieves the equivalent update info object for a specific module and version.

methods.name: determineModuleAndVersion
methods.description: Determines module name and update number from the call stack.

methods.name: deleteEquivalentUpdate
methods.description: Removes an equivalent update entry for a module and version.

methods.name: getAllEquivalentUpdates
methods.description: Returns all modules' equivalent update information.
